trainer/30369.htm.text: Master Baenedes: Nice to meet you, traveler! I'm Master Baenedes, charged with teaching Elven Warriors here. What do you seek?

trainer/30369-noteach.htm.text: Master Baenedes: I am a Master who teaches Elven Fighters. There is nothing I can teach you.

Q00156_MillenniumLove/30369-01.html.text: Master Baenedes: Theon ... Yes, I knew him well. He is the man who taught me how to use the sword and bow. A silent and stern person, but he was also a sensitive man who longed for his long lost lover. The woman he so missed ... is still alive ... the web of fate that the arachnes weave is sometime…

links.text: Say you will do the favor

Q00156_MillenniumLove/30369-04.html.text: Master Baenedes: You have not been able to find a ship returning to Talking Island yet? Please deliver Theon's Diary to Lilith, whom I'm sure is anxiously awaiting any news.

Q00156_MillenniumLove/30369-02.html.text: Master Baenedes: Please deliver this diary to Lilith. I think that is the right thing for us to do, for the sake of Theon, who has returned to the arms of Eva. If only they had learned of each other's news sooner ...

Q00156_MillenniumLove/30369-03.html.text: Master Baenedes: I understand. I can't thank you enough for granting the wishes of Lilith and coming here. May you find your destiny here ... I will ask another person to deliver the diary.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
